input: Set up a carpool schedule with school parents

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Carpool Schedule With School Parents
gold.taskDescription: Organize and coordinate a recurring carpool arrangement with other parents for school drop-offs and/or pick-ups.

questions.title: Which school and grade level is this carpool for?
questions.description: Identify the specific school and the age group of the children involved.

questions.title: How many families do you want in the carpool?
questions.description: Determine the target number of participating households to structure the rotation.

questions.title: Does this cover drop-off, pick-up, or both?
questions.description: Clarify which school runs need to be included in the schedule.

questions.title: What days of the week does the carpool need to run?
questions.description: Establish whether it is a full five-day week or selected days only.

questions.title: Do you already have parents in mind, or recruiting from scratch?
questions.description: Understand whether outreach to other parents is needed or coordination begins with an existing group.

questions.title: What tool will you use to share the schedule with parents?
questions.description: Identify the preferred communication or scheduling platform, such as a group chat, spreadsheet, or app.

questions.title: When do you need the carpool schedule to start?
questions.description: Set a target launch date to work backward and plan all coordination steps in time.
